descriptive_analysis.observable: Imaginary component and magnitude of the positive fundamental electric-field Fourier coefficient. The coefficient magnitude is not the real-space cosine peak amplitude.
descriptive_analysis.extrema_extraction: Local extrema of the absolute imaginary coefficient in the sampled trace; only four post-initial extrema are available.

four_extrema_log_magnitude_fit.note: Descriptive post-hoc fit; not a preregistered estimator or a validated damping-rate reproduction.

last_three_extrema_sensitivity_fit.note: Sensitivity result only; first post-initial extremum excluded.

linear_amplitude_scaling.note: Strong approximate 10x response scaling on this numerical configuration; not proof of continuum linearity or convergence.

limitations: This PR workflow checks out the PR merge candidate; the tested merge commit is recorded separately from the source branch commit.
Only the 64x128 grid and fixed dt=0.01 are used for the t=10 amplitude pair.
The existing space, velocity resolution, velocity-domain and timestep refinement probe ends at t=1, not t=10.
The envelope extrema and fitting window are post-hoc and only four post-initial extrema are available.
Sampling is every 0.1 time units; sub-sample peak localization is not implemented.
No independent distribution-space solver comparison has been run.
No t=10 grid, timestep or velocity-domain convergence has been established.
No runtime, peak-memory or energy-to-solution comparison is included.
The alpha=0.01 profile matches the amplitude stated in the VlasovTT paper, but does not reproduce the paper's 1024x1024 dense/TT numerical configuration.
claim_ceiling: Exploratory paired-amplitude trajectory with a strong approximate linear scaling observation. No validated Landau damping reproduction, long-horizon convergence, adaptive-grid qualification, SOTA superiority or production performance claim.
